AP® Calculus AB/BC 2024 Scoring Guidelines

Part B (AB or BC): Graphing calculator not allowed 
Question 4 
9 points

General Scoring Notes
The model solution is presented using standard mathematical notation.

Answers (numeric or algebraic) need not be simplified. Answers given as a decimal approximation should be 
correct to three places after the decimal point. Within each individual free-response question, at most one 
point is not earned for inappropriate rounding.

The graph of the differentiable function f, shown for minus 6 less than equal to x less than equal to 7, has a horizontal tangent at x = minus 2 and is linear for 0 less than equal to x less than equal to 7. Let R be the region in the second quadrant bounded by the graph of f, the vertical line x = minus 6, and the x- and y -axes. Region R has area 12.
